name: Darktube — Dual Engine Video Production v2

nodes.name: Normalize + Auto Engine
nodes.notes: Decide engine: pop/karaoke → Remotion | subtitle → Hyperframes

nodes.name: Route to Engine
nodes.notes: Roteia para o engine decidido automaticamente pelo Normalize

nodes.name: Remotion Render
nodes.notes: POST /render → 202 imediato, server renderiza async e callback

nodes.name: Hyperframes Render
nodes.notes: POST /render → 202 imediato, server renderiza async e callback

nodes.name: Wait Render
nodes.notes: Aguarda POST de callback do remotion-server ou hyperframes-server com { status, video_url }

parameters.jsonBody:
={
  "template_id":   "{{ $('Normalize + Auto Engine').item.json.tpl.id }}",
  "session_id":    "{{ $('Normalize + Auto Engine').item.json.session_id }}",
  "render_engine": "{{ $('Normalize + Auto Engine').item.json.render_engine }}",
  "video_url":     "{{ $('Wait Render').item.json.video_url }}",
  "thumbnail_url": "{{ $('Generate Thumbnail').item.json.image_url || '' }}",
  "status":        "completed"
}

_meta.flow: Webhook → Normalize(auto-engine) → SplitBatches[Image→TTS→Whisper→BuildScene loop] → Aggregate → RouteEngine → Remotion|Hyperframes → WaitCallback → Blotato → DarkTube
